title: Arc Search Android screenshot preview measurements
caveat: Coordinates were manually read from rendered web previews, not original image binaries. Preview canvas sizes do not establish source-native pixels or display density. Bounding boxes are approximate (typically ±4–8 preview px). Do not convert directly to dp or use visual color estimates as exact RGB samples. Marketing composition entries use a larger 506x900 preview where available; these bounds are relative to that promo canvas and never assert native app dp. Five modern Lazyweb screenshots are recorded as iOS-only exclusions. Six 9to5Google Android beta onboarding frames are included at publisher-resized 460px-wide coordinates. They are full-bleed captures without perspective, but still resampled files, not source-device raw pixels. Calibrated region boxes for Android Authority full-screen JPEGs (1080x2520), 9to5Google onboarding WebP files (460x1024), and designer content composites (1200x660) were scaled into each downloaded file's encoded pixel coordinate space. RGB samples from those boxes are exact for the chosen rectangles, while the manually chosen rectangle boundaries remain approximate. Other aspect-ratio-mismatched composites remain skipped.

items.state: Home, search suggestions, Browse for Me answer, webpage with expanded controls
observations: Source URL advertises a 1200x667 output; the image tiles four Android screen states horizontally, with approximately 300px width allocated per screen panel.

No handset perspective distortion is visible, unlike the separate phone photographs. These are the most useful public Android-native geometry references in this pass, but remain publisher-resized composites rather than original device screenshots.
Panel 1: nearly empty gradient home, centered mark, plus control and settings control.
Panel 2: dark search area with query pill and six visible suggestion rows, each with separate Browse for Me pills; row intervals about 52–60 composite pixels.
Panel 3: web page-like Browse for Me layout with top query pill, portrait image carousel, blue heading, structured body and three-part bottom dock.

Panel 4: webpage remains visible above a lower controls surface. Top row includes back/forward, URL/domain, link/copy and reload; action grid includes Translate, Pin, Find and Share; following rows expose Zoom, Desktop Site, Site Settings and blocked-ad/tracker status.
All coordinates are within the 1200x667 montage canvas and must not be mistaken for density-scaled dp.
